title: Gene models (GENCODE 50, lifted to GRCh37)
description: Protein-coding and non-coding genes from the current GENCODE release, mapped back to GRCh37, one representative transcript per gene (Ensembl canonical where tagged). Replaces the frozen 2014 Ensembl 75 models.
licence: Open access, no restrictions (GENCODE / EMBL-EBI terms of use)
citation: Mudge JM et al. GENCODE 2025: reference gene annotation for human and mouse. Nucleic Acids Res. 2025;53:D966–D975
